SELECT rb.rank_position, rb.member_id, m.nickname, m.profile, rb.return_rate, COALESCE(tc.trade_count, 0) AS trade_count, COALESCE(pp.profit, 0) AS profit
FROM ranking_board rb
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = rb.member_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.member_id, COUNT(t.trade_id) AS trade_count FROM account a JOIN trade t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.member_id ) tc ON tc.member_id = rb.member_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.member_id, SUM( (CAST(s.current_price AS SIGNED) - CAST(h.avg_price AS SIGNED)) * CAST(h.quantity AS SIGNED) ) AS profit FROM account a JOIN holding h ON h.account_id = a.account_id JOIN stock s ON s.stock_code = h.stock_code GROUP BY a.member_id ) pp ON pp.member_id = rb.member_id
WHERE rb.stock_code IS NULL
AND rb.rank_date = ( SELECT MAX(rank_date) FROM ranking_board WHERE stock_code IS NULL )
ORDER BY rb.rank_position ASC
LIMIT 5
